label: Product launch video
description: Market, launch, or showcase a product, app, site, or company from a URL, script, or brief. SaaS promos, feature reveals, demos. Strongest at 30-90s.

seam.note: product-launch-video injects push-slide/zoom-through/crossfade, which overlap wrappers by design, so zero-overlap fails on every cut. Advisory here; direction and continuity findings still matter.

axes.label: Story arc
axes.guidance: Fixes the beat order. Read product-launch-video/references/story-design.md § 2. If the product truth cannot support this arc (e.g. Demo Loop with no capturable UI), take the nearest arc that can and record why in NOTES.md.

axes.label: Hook
axes.guidance: The opening 3-5s. Speaks the viewer's outcome language, never a feature list (story-design.md § 3, HOOK script bank).

axes.label: Frame preset
axes.guidance: Pass to build-frame.mjs --preset. A BRIEF.md style_preset always wins over this axis.

axes.label: Tempo
values: punchy: beats of 2-3s, hard cuts on VO phrase boundaries, bold/launch voice
measured: beats of 3-5s, one reveal per VO cue, restrained B2B voice
cinematic: fewer, longer beats, camera with intent, stillness before every climax

dimensions.question: Do the first 3 seconds create tension, curiosity, or desire in the viewer's outcome language, before any company description?

anchors.2: opens on a logo or a company description
anchors.8: a real hook that makes you keep watching

dimensions.question: Is the product shown as it really is (captured UI and assets, traceable claims), with no invented features or fake UI?

anchors.8: the real product, clearly shown working
anchors.10: the product's best moment, shown better than its own site does

dimensions.question: Does the brief's promise land by beat 2, with every later beat as evidence and a clear CTA?

anchors.8: promise early, evidence after, crisp CTA
anchors.10: you could repeat the pitch after one watch

dimensions.question: Do cuts carry momentum in one dominant direction, reveals land on VO cues, and frames keep developing instead of front-loading then freezing?

anchors.5: every frame animates in, then waits

dimensions.question: Hierarchy, focal element, caption keep-out respected, contrast, phone readability in every proof frame?

anchors.10: every frame could be a key visual

dimensions.question: Does it look and sound like this brand (colors, type, voice), not a generic launch template?

anchors.5: brand colors on a generic template
anchors.10: feels made by the brand's own studio

dimensions.question: Does the length feel earned, with no dead holds and no rushed reads?

fatal: visible glitch: white flash, pop, blank or black frame
captions collide with content or are missing while VO plays
text unreadable in a key beat
required brand asset missing, distorted, or recolored
